design.flush_inside_unmount: the unmount flushes and refuses to proceed if the flush fails, so a caller never has to remember to flush first
design.no_mnt_force: MNT_FORCE is gone. A forced unmount evicts a volume that still has users, which would make the busy case pass for the wrong reason.

corrections_from_codex.detail: the number user space must pass is 0x20007805 -- IOC_VOID | group | num; my 0x00007805 had dropped the IOC_VOID bit
the flush argument needs _IOWR; after the change, rc=0 done=1 instead of done=0

self_inflicted.what: changed the ioctl to _IOWR but did not rebuild the user program
self_inflicted.symptom: rc=-1 and not one flush line in the kernel log
self_inflicted.lesson: a source change is not an image change -- the same mistake as the -DXNU_RETURN_AFTER edit earlier

also_fixed: xnusys_zonewrite in rc returned the system to the loader before later programs could run; rc is now only what this round needs
not_yet: an injected flush failure to exercise the refusing branch (the code is there, never taken)
